messages.text: What evidence is required to compare our Vector Network Analyzer solution with a competitor for Semiconductor without making unsupported claims?

### Short answer
The current passages do not provide enough evidence to compare an R&S Vector Network Analyzer solution with a competitor specifically for Semiconductor; they provide R&S VNA specifications, semiconductor-adjacent IC solution clues, and limited Keysight ENA/PNA mentions without model-level specifications or test conditions [32][39][42][96].
### Evidence required
| Required evidence | Why it is required | Current support / gap |
|---|---|---|
| A direct Semiconductor use-case source tying the application to VNA measurements | The ICs sheet lists GPU, CPU, DRAM, IC/IP/process, wafer foundry, packaging test, test interface, networking, BMC, and high-speed transmission IC categories, and it lists R&S ZNA, R&S ZNA67EXT, and R&S FSWP only as solution clues [96]. | The mapping page says these are sales/test solution clues, not formal product configurations, customer relationships, or verified opportunities [32]. |
| Exact R&S VNA configuration | R&S ZNA covers ZNA26, ZNA43, ZNA50, and ZNA67 from 10 MHz to 67 GHz [4]. | R&S ZNA67EXT is a 1.0 mm VNA system from 10 MHz to 110 GHz and is valid only in the specified system configuration [13][15]. |
| Exact competitor VNA configuration | Keysight ENA and PNA are only identified as platforms in PCB test images for materials measurement, Delta-L, TDR, and Dk/Df extraction [37][40]. | The current ENA/PNA pages do not provide specific model, frequency range, option code, calibration kit, TDR option, performance metrics, or test conditions [39][42]. |
| Competitor official or third-party validated documents | The Keysight page states that R&S battle-card competitor descriptions need Keysight official data or third-party data verification [34]. | The current Keysight sources do not provide formal datasheets, document versions, order numbers, option codes, release status, or test conditions for the cited competitor material [34]. |
| Matching measurement conditions | ZNB3000 specification data is valid at +18 °C to +28 °C, and measurement accuracy requires calibration temperature variation within 1 °C, identical measurement and calibration frequency points, bandwidth, and sweep time, with no interpolation [8]. | ZNB3000 dynamic range specifications are defined at 10 Hz measurement bandwidth without user correction applied [10]. |
| Proper treatment of warranted vs non-warranted values | R&S specifications with limits and specifications without limits represent warranted product performance [1]. | R&S typical data, nominal values, measured values, and non-traceable specifications with limits are not guaranteed [1]. |
| Like-for-like R&S performance metrics | R&S ZNA key data includes dynamic range, sensitivity, power sweep range, source power linearity, receiver compression, trace noise, and a sweep-speed example with stated conditions [6]. | R&S ZNA measurement speed data also specifies firmware version, Windows version, bandwidth, point count, and data-transfer conditions [57]. |
| Like-for-like option evidence | R&S ZNA-K2 is Time domain analysis, R&S ZNA-K20 is extended time domain including eye diagram, R&S ZNA-K8 is mmWave converter support, and R&S ZNA-K17 is increased IF bandwidth 30 MHz [60]. | The competitor side lacks equivalent option names, option codes, and comparable specifications in the current passages [39][42]. |
| No unsupported market-share, adoption, or customer claims | The Keysight page states it does not infer Keysight market share, customers, shipments, or adoption status [35]. | The AISeverEcosystem source does not clarify whether company lists are a market list, prospect list, customer list, investment watchlist, or internal sales focus [29]. |
| No unsupported customer-success claim | The LSmtron passage lists Customer: LSmtron, Product: ZNB40, Competitor: Keysight ENA, and a board-to-board connector DUT [49]. | The LSmtron limitation says the source does not state whether LSmtron purchased, evaluated, ran a PoC, or was only a sales-success-story target [50]. |
### Bottom line
A defensible comparison needs a Semiconductor-specific source, exact R&S and competitor VNA configurations, official or third-party competitor specifications, identical test conditions, and clear separation of warranted specifications from typical, nominal, measured, or non-traceable values [1][8][32][34][39][42][96].

ZNA_specs_en_5215-4652-22_v2400 › 規格條件與資料定義
- Specifications with limits：表示 warranted product performance；以 <、≤、>、≥、±、maximum、limit of、minimum 等符號標示；compliance 由 testing 確保或由 design 推導。
- Non-traceable specifications with limits（n. trc.）：依 specifications with limits 指定與測試，但因缺乏可追溯至 national metrology standards 的 measuring equipment，product performance 不保證。
- Specifications without limits：表示 warranted product performance；未特別標記時表示數值沒有或只有可忽略偏差。
- Typical data（typ.）：representative information；若標示 <、> 或 range，代表約 80% instruments 在 production time 可達成的 performance，其他情況代表 mean value。
- Nominal values（nom.）：representative value；production 期間不測試該 parameter。
- Measured values（meas.）：individual samples 的 measurement results。
- Uncertainties：coverage factor 2，依 Guide to the Expression of Uncertainty in Measurement（GUM），並考量 environmental conditions、aging、wear and tear。
- 來源明確說明：non-traceable specifications with limits、typical data、nominal values、measured values 不由 Rohde & Schwarz 保證。

ZNA_specs_en_5215-4652-22_v2400 › 與既有知識的關係
- 本來源補齊 [[R&S ZNA]] 主系列，與既有 [[R&S ZNA67EXT]] 形成關聯：[[R&S ZNA67EXT]] 是 1.0 mm Vector Network Analyzer System，量測範圍 10 MHz to 110 GHz；本來源的 [[R&S ZNA67]] 是 67 GHz base VNA 型號，並可透過 [[mmWave converter support]] 與 accessories 延伸應用。
- 本來源與既有 [[R&S FSW]]、[[R&S FSWP]]、[[R&S FSWX]] 等 spectrum / phase-noise analyzer 頁面在 [[Spectrum analyzer mode]]、[[Phase noise]]、[[Noise figure measurement]] 等功能上有橫向關聯，但本來源屬於 VNA 產品規格，不應與市場或技術背景合併。
- [[R&S ZNA-K980]] HUMS 與既有其他產品頁的 [[Health and utilization monitoring service]] 有橫向關聯；本來源列出 SNMP、REST JSON、SCPI、device web 等 readout/display protocols。

ZNA_specs_en_5215-4652-22_v2400 › 原文未解的問題
- 來源有列出大量 options、accessories 與相依關係；本次 wiki 摘要保留主要可報價項目的 code、order no.、名稱與原文相依關係，但未逐字展開所有 calibration accessories、test cables、switch matrix extensions 的完整規格表。
- 部分表格同時出現 spec.、typ.、meas. 或 nom. 數值；本摘要依原文標示保留，不自行調和。
- 來源註明 Internal PC is subject to change without notice；因此 internal PC 規格需以此 Version 24.00（April 2026）為準。
- [[R&S ZNA-K121]] RF off boot up 在本次來源摘錄中列出名稱，但未提供 Order No.；頁面標示為來源未標示。
- 讀圖補充 p050 的尺寸數值旁單位無法辨識；不得推論為 mm 或其他單位。
- 本次輸入摘錄未提供讀圖頁面的圖片嵌入 wikilink，故 wiki 無法帶入原圖供核對。

R&S ZNA
[[R&S ZNA]] 是 Rohde & Schwarz 的 Vector Network Analyzer 系列，依 Version 24.00（April 2026）規格書涵蓋 [[R&S ZNA26]]、[[R&S ZNA43]]、[[R&S ZNA50]]、[[R&S ZNA67]]，頻率範圍從 10 MHz 延伸到最高 67 GHz。

R&S ZNA › 文件依據
- 來源：[[ZNA_specs_en_5215-4652-22_v2400]]。
- 文件：R&S®ZNA Vector Network Analyzer Specifications。
- 文件編號：PD 5215.4652.22。
- 文件版本：Version 24.00。
- 發布時間：April 2026。

R&S ZNA › Key performance（Version 24.00）
- Dynamic range：> 129 dB specification without options；147 dB typical with options；maximum attainable range up to 170 dB allowing full 2-port correction。
- Sensitivity：> –120 dBm，1 Hz IF bandwidth，specification without options；–162 dBm，1 Hz IF bandwidth，measured with options。來源註明 –162 dBm 是以 1 kHz measurement bandwidth 量測後 normalized to 1 Hz。
- Power sweep range：100 dB typical continuous electronic sweep range；可使用 mechanical step attenuators 位移 sweep range。
- Source power linearity：0.2 dB typical，範圍 –40 dBm to +10 dBm。
- Receiver compression：0.05 dB typical，up to +8 dBm at test port，referenced to –10 dBm。
- Trace noise：0.005 dB specification RMS、0.002 dB typical RMS，條件為 10 GHz、100 kHz measurement bandwidth、0 dB reflection。
- Speed example：10 MHz to 43.5 GHz、500 kHz measurement bandwidth、1601 points、2-port calibration 時 sweep time 96 ms nominal。

ZNB3000_specs_en_3647-5184-22_v0900 › p001（讀圖）
- 可見文字：R&S®ZNB3000、VECTOR NETWORK ANALYZER、Specifications、Version 09.00、ROHDE&SCHWARZ、Make ideas real、ZNB Vector Network Analyzer。
- 頁面為文件封面樣式，主體是 R&S ZNB3000 VECTOR NETWORK ANALYZER 儀器照片。
- 儀器正面有大螢幕、右側實體按鍵與旋鈕、左右把手、前面板下方多個射頻連接埠。
- 螢幕顯示多個網路分析儀量測圖窗；圖表細部標示、座標數值與按鍵文字多數無法辨識。
- 可清楚辨識的數值只有 Version 09.00。

ZNB3000_specs_en_3647-5184-22_v0900 › 重點摘要
- Product data 適用條件：ambient temperature 儲存 3 小時後 warm-up operation 30 分鐘、符合 specified environmental conditions、遵守 recommended calibration interval，且已執行所有 applicable internal automatic adjustments。
- 所有 specification data 在 **+18 °C to +28 °C** 有效；measurement accuracy 另要求 calibration 後 temperature variation 不得超過 **1 °C**，且 measurement 與 calibration 的 frequency points、measurement bandwidth、sweep time 必須相同，不允許 interpolation。
- Measurement range：impedance 50 Ω；frequency resolution 1 Hz；number of measurement points per trace 1 to 100001。
- Measurement bandwidth：base unit **1 Hz to 1 MHz**；搭配 [[R&S ZNB3-K17]] 10 MHz receiver bandwidth option 時為 **1 Hz to 10 MHz**。
- 型號與頻率範圍：[[R&S ZNB3004]] 為 9 kHz to 4.5 GHz，搭配 [[R&S ZNB3-B082]] 或 [[R&S ZNB3-B084]] 可到 9.0 GHz；[[R&S ZNB3020]] 為 9 kHz to 20.0 GHz，搭配 [[R&S ZNB3-B262]] 或 [[R&S ZNB3-B264]] 可到 26.5 GHz；[[R&S ZNB3032]] 為 9 kHz to 32.0 GHz，搭配 [[R&S ZNB3-B442]] 或 [[R&S ZNB3-B444]] 可到 43.5 GHz；[[R&S ZNB3044]] 為 9 kHz to 43.5 GHz，搭配 [[R&S ZNB3-B542]] 或 [[R&S ZNB3-B544]] 可到 54.0 GHz。
- Dynamic range 規格以 10 Hz measurement bandwidth、without user correction applied 為條件；使用 1 Hz measurement bandwidth 可增加 dynamic range；crosstalk does not limit dynamic range。
- Measurement speed 以 firmware version 4.12 與 Windows 11 測得；來源註明 sweep time 應理解為 cycle time。
- General data：operating temperature +5 °C to +40 °C；storage temperature –20 °C to +60 °C；calibration interval 1 year；power supply 100 V to 240 V ±10 %，50 Hz to 60 Hz and 400 Hz，max. 3.5 A。
- Ordering information 列出 base units、frequency upgrade options、extended power range、receiver step attenuators、extended dynamic range、hardware options、software / measurement options、calibration accessories、power sensors、attenuators、switch matrices、test cables、hardware add-ons、warranty and service options。

ZNB3000_specs_en_3647-5184-22_v0900 › 原文未解的問題
- 來源萃取文字中，[[R&S ZNB3032]] dynamic range 小節標題寫作「with or without R&S®ZNB3-B322 / -B324」，但 ordering information 與 frequency range 小節列出 [[R&S ZNB3-B442]] / [[R&S ZNB3-B444]] 才是 ZNB3032 upgrade to 43.5 GHz。暫視為來源萃取或表頭錯位，報價與規格頁以 ordering information 明列代碼為準。
- 來源萃取文字中，[[R&S ZNB3044]] dynamic range 小節標題寫作「with or without R&S®ZNB3-B442 / -B444」，但 ordering information 與 frequency range 小節列出 [[R&S ZNB3-B542]] / [[R&S ZNB3-B544]] 才是 ZNB3044 upgrade to 54 GHz。暫視為來源萃取或表頭錯位，報價與規格頁以 ordering information 明列代碼為準。
- Power consumption 表格中有一組 2 ports max. 450 W, 145 W typ. / 4 ports max. 450 W, 200 W typ.，但型號在萃取文字中未清楚對應；本次不自行指派型號。

R&S ZNB3000 › Dynamic range 條件
- Receiver noise floor 定義為 transmission magnitude data trace 的 RMS 值，該 trace 由 noise 與 crosstalk 產生，test ports short-circuited。
- Specifications 適用於 10 Hz measurement bandwidth，without user correction applied。
- 使用 1 Hz measurement bandwidth 可增加 dynamic range。
- Crosstalk does not limit dynamic range。
- Dynamic range performance 規格化於 port 1 與 port 2 之間，以及 4-port model 的 port 3 與 port 4 之間；其他 dynamic range performance 為 typical。
- Without enhanced dynamic range mode 時，above 100 kHz 的 nominal system dynamic range 會降低 15 dB to 20 dB；below 100 kHz 的影響可能更高。

R&S ZNA67EXT › 系統構成與適用條件

### Short answer
The current passages do not provide enough evidence to compare an R&S Vector Network Analyzer solution with a competitor specifically for Semiconductor; they provide R&S VNA specifications, semiconductor-adjacent IC solution clues, and limited Keysight ENA/PNA mentions without model-level specifications or test conditions [32][39][42][96].
### Evidence required
| Required evidence | Why it is required | Current support / gap |
|---|---|---|
| A direct Semiconductor use-case source tying the application to VNA measurements | The ICs sheet lists GPU, CPU, DRAM, IC/IP/process, wafer foundry, packaging test, test interface, networking, BMC, and high-speed transmission IC categories, and it lists R&S ZNA, R&S ZNA67EXT, and R&S FSWP only as solution clues [96]. | The mapping page says these are sales/test solution clues, not formal product configurations, customer relationships, or verified opportunities [32]. |
| Exact R&S VNA configuration | R&S ZNA covers ZNA26, ZNA43, ZNA50, and ZNA67 from 10 MHz to 67 GHz [4]. | R&S ZNA67EXT is a 1.0 mm VNA system from 10 MHz to 110 GHz and is valid only in the specified system configuration [13][15]. |
| Exact competitor VNA configuration | Keysight ENA and PNA are only identified as platforms in PCB test images for materials measurement, Delta-L, TDR, and Dk/Df extraction [37][40]. | The current ENA/PNA pages do not provide specific model, frequency range, option code, calibration kit, TDR option, performance metrics, or test conditions [39][42]. |
| Competitor official or third-party validated documents | The Keysight page states that R&S battle-card competitor descriptions need Keysight official data or third-party data verification [34]. | The current Keysight sources do not provide formal datasheets, document versions, order numbers, option codes, release status, or test conditions for the cited competitor material [34]. |
| Matching measurement conditions | ZNB3000 specification data is valid at +18 °C to +28 °C, and measurement accuracy requires calibration temperature variation within 1 °C, identical measurement and calibration frequency points, bandwidth, and sweep time, with no interpolation [8]. | ZNB3000 dynamic range specifications are defined at 10 Hz measurement bandwidth without user correction applied [10]. |
| Proper treatment of warranted vs non-warranted values | R&S specifications with limits and specifications without limits represent warranted product performance [1]. | R&S typical data, nominal values, measured values, and non-traceable specifications with limits are not guaranteed [1]. |
| Like-for-like R&S performance metrics | R&S ZNA key data includes dynamic range, sensitivity, power sweep range, source power linearity, receiver compression, trace noise, and a sweep-speed example with stated conditions [6]. | R&S ZNA measurement speed data also specifies firmware version, Windows version, bandwidth, point count, and data-transfer conditions [57]. |
| Like-for-like option evidence | R&S ZNA-K2 is Time domain analysis, R&S ZNA-K20 is extended time domain including eye diagram, R&S ZNA-K8 is mmWave converter support, and R&S ZNA-K17 is increased IF bandwidth 30 MHz [60]. | The competitor side lacks equivalent option names, option codes, and comparable specifications in the current passages [39][42]. |
| No unsupported market-share, adoption, or customer claims | The Keysight page states it does not infer Keysight market share, customers, shipments, or adoption status [35]. | The AISeverEcosystem source does not clarify whether company lists are a market list, prospect list, customer list, investment watchlist, or internal sales focus [29]. |
| No unsupported customer-success claim | The LSmtron passage lists Customer: LSmtron, Product: ZNB40, Competitor: Keysight ENA, and a board-to-board connector DUT [49]. | The LSmtron limitation says the source does not state whether LSmtron purchased, evaluated, ran a PoC, or was only a sales-success-story target [50]. |
### Bottom line
A defensible comparison needs a Semiconductor-specific source, exact R&S and competitor VNA configurations, official or third-party competitor specifications, identical test conditions, and clear separation of warranted specifications from typical, nominal, measured, or non-traceable values [1][8][32][34][39][42][96].

ZNA_specs_en_5215-4652-22_v2400 › 規格條件與資料定義
- Specifications with limits：表示 warranted product performance；以 <、≤、>、≥、±、maximum、limit of、minimum 等符號標示；compliance 由 testing 確保或由 design 推導。
- Non-traceable specifications with limits（n. trc.）：依 specifications with limits 指定與測試，但因缺乏可追溯至 national metrology standards 的 measuring equipment，product performance 不保證。
- Specifications without limits：表示 warranted product performance；未特別標記時表示數值沒有或只有可忽略偏差。
- Typical data（typ.）：representative information；若標示 <、> 或 range，代表約 80% instruments 在 production time 可達成的 performance，其他情況代表 mean value。
- Nominal values（nom.）：representative value；production 期間不測試該 parameter。
- Measured values（meas.）：individual samples 的 measurement results。
- Uncertainties：coverage factor 2，依 Guide to the Expression of Uncertainty in Measurement（GUM），並考量 environmental conditions、aging、wear and tear。
- 來源明確說明：non-traceable specifications with limits、typical data、nominal values、measured values 不由 Rohde & Schwarz 保證。
